files.description: Exam scores (60 rows, one per student): student (full name, unique, many with accented letters), then math, art and music (scores 35-100, whole numbers; about 9% of these score cells are empty, and one student has no score at all).

task_text: Across all three subjects together, what share of the recorded scores (cells that have a score) is 90 or more? `result` should be one number between 0 and 1.
intended_computation: Number of non-empty score cells with a value of at least 90, divided by the 164 non-empty score cells.

acceptable_variants.notes: may be rounded to 6 significant digits.

predicted_direction.reason: The share over stack() used 164 recorded cells on 2.x; on 3.x stack() keeps the 16 empty cells, which enter the denominator.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R04; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
